title: fix(app-shell): the record page reads the lock service's 501 silently and asks no more
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xAVdK2axL7ynomwkD2iDbXe)_

Fixes #26632

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页读审批锁时不再走 SDK 客户端,改用 hook 自己的 fetch;501 静默并记住,本次页面加载内不再读锁;其它失败仍按原格式记日志。
- 为什么改:没有审批服务的部署(新脚手架)每打开一条记录就在浏览器控制台打一条红色 `HTTP request failed ... -> 501`,而 501 正是设计中的「没有锁服务」。
- 风险与回滚:只动 app-shell 一个 hook;锁读请求改走与审批列表读相同的传输,不再带 SDK 客户端的头。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts` 的 `readRecordLock` 与 `startRead` 里的读锁分支;`RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx` 新增两条用例。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx`,预期 6/6 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`useRecordApprovals` asks `GET /approvals/records/OBJECT/ID/lock` when the approvals list finds no pending request (#25934). It used to read it through `client.approvals.getRecordLock`. The SDK client logs every non-2xx with `logger.error('HTTP request failed', …)` before its caller sees the answer, and the console's client logger (`createQuietHttpLogger` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack`) prints that with `console.error`. So on a composition without the approvals service, whose designed answer to that read is `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, every record open printed a red line, although the hook already treated the 501 as "not locked".

Measured producer: `packages/client/src/index.ts` `fetch()` (the unconditional `logger.error` on `!res.ok`) → `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `createQuietHttpLogger().error` → `console.error`. The PM hypothesis held. The fix lands in app-shell, the expected file surface, so `@objectstack/client` is not changed.

- The lock is now read through the hook's own `fetchJson`, the same transport the approvals list read beside it already uses. That transport logs nothing. The `{ success, data }` envelope is unwrapped as the SDK did.
- A 501 is read silently and latched in a module-scoped flag (`recordLockAbsent`): no record asks again until the page reloads. `__resetRecordApprovalsStore` clears it.
- Any other failure still logs, through the same `createQuietHttpLogger` the SDK client would have used: `HTTP request failed: GET URL -> STATUS [CODE]`, a 404 still demoted to debug. The next open asks again.
- The read still happens only where an adapter is mounted, as before. A first draft dropped that gate, and `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010` caught the lock read appearing as a second wave on its adapter-less page. The gate is kept.

## Why

The triage ruling on the card (6441358448): the record page treats a 501 from the lock read as "no lock service", silent, no retry; any other failure still logs.

## Tests

- `RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx` now stubs the lock route on the global fetch rather than the adapter's SDK method, and pins that the SDK method is never called.
- New: the 501 logs no `console.error` line naming the lock path, and a second open of the record reads the list again but not the lock.
- New: a 500 logs one identified line (`GET … -> 500`), and the next open asks again.
- Ablation: with the 501 branch mutated to never match (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore verified by blob hash), the new 501 test went red on the `HTTP request failed: GET /api/v1/approvals/records/account/acc_northwind/lock -> 501 [NOT_IMPLEMENTED]` line, 1 failed / 5 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The browser's own network line for the first 501 still appears once per page load. JS cannot suppress it, and the console cannot know the service is absent without asking, because the approvals list door answers `200 { data: [] }` when the service is missing while the lock door answers 501. Removing that last line needs the two server doors to agree, which is `domain:server` work (`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`) and outside this card. Noted, not filed.
- The lock read no longer carries the SDK client's `X-Environment-Id` and `Accept-Language` headers. The approvals list read beside it never did, and the console's adapter sets no environment id.

## Verification

All on head a0185cfb, in a shared container (seconds are shared-box seconds).

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useRecordApprovals packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalLock packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordApprovalsPanel`: Test Files 15 passed (15), Tests 107 passed (107).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 34 derived commands, each run locally with exit 0, `pnpm check:type-check-debt` included (re-run under the verify lock after its first run could not get the lock). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.
- Narrowed, declared: the full app-shell package suite was not run to completion locally. It was stopped after 40 minutes on the shared box, after it had already surfaced the waves-13010 regression fixed above. CI's `Test UI` runs it.
